ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast heterogeneous distribution; estimated 45:55 white-to-black pixel ratio across visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large white contiguous regions on lateral lobes; dense black pigmentation along median notch area and peripheral margins; recurring small circular white/black focal spots distributed bilaterally.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an approximate 65-degree angle; depth extends significantly into the central fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude peaks ranging from small notches to prominent jagged protrusions along the entire trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Distinct concave curvature along the trailing edge extending to sharp, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white circular clusters (barnacle scars) localized at the distal tips of both lobes; multiple ring-shaped focal anomalies present on the interior lobe surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent white linear pixel disruptions; vertical and diagonal rake marks visible on the right lobe; shorter horizontal abrasions on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive scarring at the fluke tips and numerous linear rake marks across the surface pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive 'bullseye' marks consisting of dark central pixels surrounded by white circular rings, most notably on the lower-left and mid-right fluke regions.
